properties.name: cosky.enabled
properties.description: Whether CoSky is on at all: loading Configs, discovery, registration and the health indicator.

properties.name: cosky.endpoints
properties.description: Servers to try in turn, each host:port.

properties.name: cosky.token
properties.description: Token sent on every call. A blank one, as ${COSKY_TOKEN:} gives while the variable is not set, counts as none.

properties.name: cosky.token-file
properties.description: A file holding the token instead, such as a mounted secret. Read again once it changes, so a rotated token needs no restart.

properties.name: cosky.namespace
properties.description: Namespace the application imports Configs from, discovers services in and registers in.

properties.name: cosky.tls.enabled
properties.description: Whether to connect over TLS. Without it the token crosses the network in the clear.

properties.name: cosky.tls.trusted-certificates
properties.description: A PEM file to trust, for a private CA. The JVM's trust store decides otherwise.

properties.name: cosky.snapshot.enabled
properties.description: Whether to keep views on disk, which a restart starts from until it reaches a server.

properties.name: cosky.snapshot.dir
properties.description: Directory of the snapshots, ~/.cosky by default.

properties.name: cosky.snapshot.include-config
properties.description: Whether snapshots hold Config contents. Snapshots are not encrypted, so false keeps Config contents off the disk.

properties.name: cosky.registry.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register this application, as service spring.application.name.

properties.name: cosky.registry.weight
properties.description: Weight of this application's instance. 0 takes no traffic.

properties.name: cosky.discovery.enabled
properties.description: Whether to provide DiscoveryClient, ReactiveDiscoveryClient and LoadBalancer's instances.

properties.name: cosky.discovery.load-timeout
properties.description: How long the first read of a service waits. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.config.load-timeout
properties.description: How long importing a Config waits. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.config.refresh.enabled
properties.description: Whether to publish a RefreshEvent when an imported Config changes.

properties.name: management.health.cosky.enabled
properties.description: Whether to report the connection to the server as health indicator cosky.
